Thanks — I reviewed the attachments. Notes:

- COI: the Additional Insured naming "customers" is broad. Standard Redwood language is: 
  "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their respective officers, directors and employees" as Additional Insured. Adding customers is acceptable only if limited to "customers of Redwood Inference in connection with services provided by SolisCloud".
- Waiver of Subrogation: present and acceptable.
- Limits: meet our baseline (1M/2M/1M) — verified on the COI.
- Subcontractor list: vendor disclosed three named subs — please confirm SolisCloud will require subs to carry same minimums.

I attached a redline of the MPA with two minor clarifications on insurance exhibits (see MPA_redline_SolisCloud.docx). Operationally I recommend: create a conditional PO now so engineering can start onboarding (PO flagged "pending final COI endorsement"), require final endorsed COI uploaded to vendor portal within 14 calendar days of PO issuance, and withhold the first invoice clearance until the final COI is received.

Action items for Daniel: please upload an endorsed COI that follows the clarified Additional Insured scope and confirm subcontractor coverage commitments. Also include W9 so finance can complete vendor record.

Attachment: MPA_redline_SolisCloud.docx (docx)

-Marissa Cole
